title: Account-Standing Schedule for Advance Payments of Pre-K Tuition
content:
**Schedule.** Under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the discount on an advance payment of Pre-K tuition is reduced when the account carries arrears at the time of the advance.

The whole months of arrears are the enrollment's tuition charges and late fees less its payments, divided by the most recent billing month's tuition charge and rounded down to a whole number. Credits are not payments and are not subtracted.

| Whole months of arrears when the advance is made | Taken off the discount |
|---|---|
| three or more | 20.00 |
| two | 10.00 |
| one or none | nothing |

## Worked cases (hypothetical enrollment, most recent tuition charge 300.00)

| Charges and late fees to date | Payments to date | Arrears divided by 300.00 | Whole months | Taken off the discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1,800.00 | 900.00 | 3.0 | 3 | 20.00 |
| 1,800.00 | 1,050.00 | 2.5 | 2 | 10.00 |
| 1,800.00 | 1,250.00 | 1.83 | 1 | nothing |
